scripts.dev: concurrently -n proxy,shell,admin,provider -c yellow,magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev:proxy" "npm run dev -w @mawaqeet/shell" "npm run dev -w @mawaqeet/admin" "npm run dev -w @mawaqeet/provider"
scripts.dev:proxy: microfrontends proxy apps/shell/microfrontends.json --port 4000 --local-apps shell admin provider
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mawaqeet/admin && npm run build -w @mawaqeet/provider && npm run build -w @mawaqeet/shell
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @mawaqeet/admin && npm run lint -w @mawaqeet/provider && npm run lint -w @mawaqeet/shell
